01 · Кому подходит курс

🎬 КАМЕРА. Средний крупный план, спокойное приветствие. Все реплики запиши на камеру. Экраны для монтажа снимай отдельным проходом. Не добавляй обещаний работы, грейда или сертификации.

Hi, I’m Stanislav. Welcome to Salesforce Automation Mastery. This community is for developers who want to understand Salesforce more deeply and become more confident building, explaining, and reviewing real features. You might be starting with CRM for the first time, moving beyond familiar Apex tasks, or preparing to discuss architecture and performance in an interview.

02 · Учебный проект

🎬 МОНТАЖ ПОЗЖЕ · B01. Поверх следующей реплики вставь 8–12 секунд учебного проекта: synthetic Contact → Vehicle → Test Drive. Записывай экраны отдельно от речи, без реальных клиентов.

We learn through Northstar Motors, a fictional car dealership. A customer asks for a test drive. A salesperson needs to find the right vehicle, record the appointment, and hand the work to a colleague. As the application grows, we add access control, automation, interfaces, integrations, and ways to recover when something fails. You can see what each technical decision changes for the people using the system.

03 · Junior

🎬 МОНТАЖ ПОЗЖЕ · B02. Classroom → Junior → J00 contents. Покажи J01, J07, J17 и J28, затем один practical outcome. Во время основной записи продолжай говорить в камеру.

The Junior path starts with what a CRM is, how Salesforce stores information, and how to find your way around an org. You build the data model, configure access, create a Flow, write Apex, and build a first Lightning Web Component. The goal is a small working feature that you can explain and hand over with tests and clear instructions.

04 · Middle и Senior

🎬 МОНТАЖ ПОЗЖЕ · B03. Покажи M00 и S00, затем короткие фрагменты async state diagram и measured improvement worksheet. Не выдавай маленький demo fixture за enterprise load test.

The Middle path connects those foundations. We work with asynchronous processing, API contracts, component communication, events, source control, and failure handling. The Senior path focuses on decisions: locating a performance problem, understanding access at scale, keeping integrations reliable, and changing an existing system without losing control of its behavior. You support your choices with evidence and explain the limits of what you tested.

05 · Agentforce и поиск работы

🎬 МОНТАЖ ПОЗЖЕ · B04. Покажи Agentforce course contents и confirmation → persisted record. Затем Job Research course и portfolio checklist. Live agent trace используй только после фактической записи в поддерживаемой org.

There is also a practical Agentforce project. You build an employee assistant that reads demo options, asks for confirmation, and creates a booking or a support Case. The Job Research course helps you turn your work into an honest CV and portfolio, research suitable roles, and practise technical interviews. We keep the focus on what you can demonstrate and explain.

06 · Как выглядит обучение

🎬 МОНТАЖ ПОЗЖЕ · B05. Открой J04: practical outcome → demonstration → independent practice → acceptance. Затем портал: rotating self-check и submit form. Не отправляй фиктивную заявку в рабочую очередь.

Each lesson gives you a practical outcome, an explanation, steps to try, and a check for deciding whether the work is ready. Read a small section, build that part, and compare the actual result with the expected one. Use the practice portal for self-checks and project submissions. The written lesson remains your reference while you work, so you can return to a step without searching through a long video.

07 · С чего начать

🎬 КАМЕРА. Заверши прямым приглашением к первому действию. МОНТАЖ ПОЗЖЕ · B06: Classroom → нужный курс → его contents page. Цены и условия персонального review в этом видео не называй: их нужно сверять с действующими настройками.

Start in the Classroom and open the contents page for the path that matches your experience. If you are new to Salesforce, begin with Junior and take the lessons in order. If you already build features, use the practical checks to find the gaps you want to work on. Choose one exercise, save your result, and explain how you know it works. That is where we begin.

01 · Выбор маршрута

🎬 ЭКРАН. Открой contents page курса junior. Покажи prerequisites и результат проекта.

No previous CRM or Salesforce experience is required. Begin with people, business information, and a personal learning org. Apex syntax and browser-language basics are taught before their application code. Complete the separate workspace guide before code deployment. Deliver and explain a small Salesforce feature with a deliberate data model, restricted-user access evidence, automation, bulk-aware Apex, a usable interface, tests, and a reproducible handover.

02 · CRM and Salesforce Foundations

🎬 ЭКРАН. Прокрути до «CRM and Salesforce Foundations». Открой один прямой lesson link, покажи practical outcome и вернись в contents.

This part covers crm and salesforce foundations. Follow one customer request and discover why a team needs shared information, clear responsibility, and a next action. Distinguish a product, an application, and an org while learning who uses and changes Salesforce. Use a browser to create a personal Salesforce learning environment and verify that you can return to the same one.

03 · Data and the First Application

🎬 ЭКРАН. Прокрути до «Data and the First Application». Открой один прямой lesson link, покажи practical outcome и вернись в contents.

This part covers data and the first application. Classify customer information using Lead, Account, Contact, Opportunity, and Case, then explain why the course adds two custom objects. Separate entered values, calculated values, and rejected input using concrete appointment examples. Compare relationship behaviour while preserving independent ownership of the course Test Drive records.

04 · Designing and Verifying Access

🎬 ЭКРАН. Прокрути до «Designing and Verifying Access». Открой один прямой lesson link, покажи practical outcome и вернись в contents.

This part covers designing and verifying access. Separate sign-in, object operations, field permissions, and access to an individual record. Create an additive permission set that enables appointment work without broad administration. Use Private defaults, roles, and a focused sharing rule to explain appointment visibility.

05 · Flow, Apex, and Transaction Behaviour

🎬 ЭКРАН. Прокрути до «Flow, Apex, and Transaction Behaviour». Открой один прямой lesson link, покажи practical outcome и вернись в contents.

This part covers flow, apex, and transaction behaviour. Create one follow-up Task for a new appointment request, avoid update duplicates, and make a failed reminder visible. Read and write a small pure Apex function before introducing database operations. Write a bounded bulk operation with explicit user-mode access and separate reads from writes.

06 · Components, Diagnosis, and Handover

🎬 ЭКРАН. Прокрути до «Components, Diagnosis, and Handover». Открой один прямой lesson link, покажи practical outcome и вернись в contents.

This part covers components, diagnosis, and handover. Learn the browser-language basics and build an explicitly simulated appointment preview with four visible states. Use a standard record form for an ordinary edit and verify the result under a restricted user. Split a small interface into a parent and child with clear ownership of state.

07 · Первое действие

🎬 ЭКРАН. Покажи первый lesson link и правило self-check. Не открывай все уроки подряд.

Begin with the first lesson you have not yet completed. Keep a short record of your expected result, your actual result, and what you changed. Use the acceptance checks before moving on. If you already know a topic, demonstrate its practical result before skipping it.

02 · Start with a conversation

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «Start with a conversation». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

Northstar Motors is our fictional car dealership: a business that helps people choose and buy cars. Irina is interested in a vehicle and asks whether she can try driving it before deciding. That short trial is a test drive. Anna is a salesperson. Her job is to answer Irina's questions, find a suitable vehicle, and arrange the next step. A customer is the person receiving help from the business; in this lesson that includes someone who has not bought anything yet. Anna learns that Irina wants a blue car and can speak tomorrow afternoon. She writes a telephone number on a piece of paper. The next day Anna is away. Max, another salesperson, takes over. He has the number but does not know what Anna promised. Calling immediately could mean repeating questions, offering the wrong vehicle, or missing an agreed appointment. This is an information problem before it is a software problem.

03 · Separate history, responsibility, and the next action

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «Separate history, responsibility, and the next action». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

CRM stands for customer relationship management. A CRM system is software that helps a business keep useful information about customers and its work with them. The useful information is more than a directory of names. Northstar needs the request, previous conversations, agreements, and the work still to be done. Salesforce provides CRM products; we will introduce it separately in J02. History describes something that already happened: Anna discussed the blue vehicle on Monday. A next action describes work that has not happened: call Irina on Tuesday afternoon. Responsibility names the person who should do it: Max. A due time makes the promise concrete. These ideas are related, but one does not replace another. Writing 'customer called' does not tell Max what to do next.

04 · Work through the handover

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «Work through the handover». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

Make a small handover note before opening any software. Use fictional details only. Do not invent a confirmed appointment: Irina has asked about a test drive, but a time has not yet been agreed. Distinguishing an enquiry from a commitment prevents a persuasive-looking screen from hiding an inaccurate business record.

02 · A product solves a category of work

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «A product solves a category of work». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

Salesforce is both a company name and the name people use for its family of business software. A company can use Salesforce products to support work such as sales or customer service. A product provides a collection of capabilities for a particular purpose. This does not mean every Salesforce customer owns every product or sees the same features. Northstar's salespeople need customer details and follow-up work. Its support staff need to track customer problems. A ready-made product can provide a starting point. Northstar may still need changes to match how it arranges test drives. A developer should first understand the available capabilities instead of assuming that every requirement needs a new program.

03 · The platform and an individual environment

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «The platform and an individual environment». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

The Salesforce platform provides tools for storing data, controlling access, creating applications, and adding business behaviour. An application brings together screens and functions used for a task. Some changes can be made using configuration: settings chosen through the interface. Others require code: written instructions that a programming language can execute. Both approaches still need clear requirements and testing. An org, short for organization, is a separate Salesforce environment containing its own data, users, and configuration. A user is an account through which a person signs in. Northstar's working org is distinct from your personal learning org. Creating a learning org does not grant access to an employer's customer information.

04 · People and responsibilities

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «People and responsibilities». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

Anna and Max use the system to carry out sales work. Oleg defines the team's needs and checks whether the result helps the business. A Salesforce administrator changes configuration, manages access, and maintains the application. A Salesforce developer writes and maintains code when the solution needs it. These are responsibilities, not rigid boundaries: a developer also uses configuration, and a small team may combine several jobs.

02 · Know which account opens which place

Trailhead is Salesforce's learning website. It contains explanations and exercises. A Trailhead Playground is a Salesforce org intended for hands-on learning. 02 · Understand the screen before changing it

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «Understand the screen before changing it». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

An interface is the collection of pages, menus, fields, and controls through which a person uses software. Lightning Experience is Salesforce's main modern desktop interface. Your learning org may show different applications or labels from an illustration because its language, configuration, and permissions can differ. We will explain the purpose of each area rather than rely on a pixel-perfect screenshot. The App Launcher, commonly shown as a grid of dots, helps you find available applications and items. Search for Sales to open a sales workspace if it is available. The application name helps you recognize where you are. Its navigation items lead to areas such as Contacts. A contact is information about a person; we will examine the underlying data model in J05 and J07.

03 · Move from several records to one record

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «Move from several records to one record». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

A record is information about one specific item, such as one person or one test drive. A list shows several records so that you can find and compare them. A list view is a selected way of displaying that list, often with conditions that determine which records appear. 'Recently Viewed' is therefore not a promise to display every contact in the org. Suppose Anna wants Irina's telephone number. She opens Contacts, finds the appropriate person, and opens the record. The record page presents information about that one contact. A Details area commonly displays field values, while Related presents associated information where the page supports it. The list and the record page are different views of the same stored information, not separate copies of the person.

04 · Keep configuration separate from daily work

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «Keep configuration separate from daily work». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

Setup is the configuration area of Salesforce. When permitted, you can reach it through the gear menu. It is where an administrator manages features such as users and object definitions. Entering a telephone number for one customer is everyday data work. Adding a new kind of field to store telephone numbers is a configuration change that can affect many records.

02 · One catalogue, several vehicles

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «One catalogue, several vehicles». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

Northstar needs to keep information about vehicles it can offer customers. An object describes a kind of information stored in Salesforce. Our example is Vehicle. A field describes one property of that kind of item, such as Model or Status. A record stores the values for one particular vehicle. Two physical vehicles require two records, even if their models are identical. Imagine a table with Model, VIN, and Status as column headings. Each row describes a vehicle. The table is a useful analogy for an object, the column headings resemble fields, and the rows resemble records. The analogy helps you read the structure; it does not mean Salesforce is simply a spreadsheet or that every application must be designed as one large table.

03 · Separate a field definition from its value

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «Separate a field definition from its value». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

The course starter uses Vehicle__c, with Model__c, VIN__c, and Status__c. The __c suffix identifies a custom object or field in these API names. An API name is the identifier used by configuration files and code; the visible label is the name a user reads. For now, recognize the distinction without memorizing every naming rule. Model__c is a text field. 'City EV' is one possible value. Status__c is a picklist: a field offering a defined set of choices. In the starter those choices are Available, Reserved, and Unavailable. VIN__c is text with a uniqueness constraint in this educational schema. A constraint is a rule the system applies to stored data. We use fictional identifiers, not real vehicle or customer information.

04 · Introduce relationships carefully

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «Introduce relationships carefully». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

A test drive is a separate event involving a vehicle and a customer. Northstar may run several test drives for the same vehicle on different days. Copying the entire vehicle description into every event would make updates difficult. A relationship instead points from one record to another, allowing the event to identify its vehicle.

02 · A short request contains unanswered decisions

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «A short request contains unanswered decisions». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

Oleg asks, 'Please add test-drive booking to Salesforce.' This expresses a useful direction, but it is not yet a complete task. Who makes the booking? What information is required? What does booking mean: recording a request, reserving a vehicle, or confirming a customer appointment? These choices affect the data, permissions, and behaviour that the team will eventually build. Start with the people. Anna needs to record the vehicle and time agreed with Irina so that Max can host the appointment when Anna is away. Anna is the user of this proposed function; Irina is the customer receiving the service. The request does not imply that Irina needs a Salesforce login. Separating the person using the screen from the person affected by the business outcome prevents an unnecessary external portal.

03 · Ask questions in a workable order

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «Ask questions in a workable order». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

First identify the information. Does the vehicle already exist in the catalogue? How is the customer identified? Which time zone does the team use? Then identify the actions: can Anna create, change, confirm, and cancel the appointment? Finally investigate exceptional situations: a vehicle becomes unavailable, a time is already occupied, or Irina changes her mind. Do not quietly invent answers. Write unknowns as questions and proposals as proposals. Oleg might decide that the first version simply records an appointment after a salesperson checks availability manually. Automatic calendar coordination would then be a later feature. That is a legitimate small scope when it is agreed and described honestly.

Acceptance criteria are conditions used to decide whether the agreed behaviour has been delivered. 'Make booking easy' is too ambiguous to test on its own. 'Anna selects an existing vehicle and future time, saves the appointment, reopens it, and sees the same values' describes observable actions and results. A reviewer can repeat that scenario.

02 · Match an object to the question it answers

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «Match an object to the question it answers». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

A standard object is supplied by Salesforce for a common category of work. A custom object is a structure a team adds for its own application. Starting with standard objects can preserve useful existing behaviour and familiar terminology. It is not a command to force every business concept into an unsuitable object. A Lead commonly represents an early prospect whose suitability or next step is still being assessed. An Account commonly represents a business or organization, and a Contact represents a person associated with business relationships. An Opportunity tracks a potential sale, including its progress. A Case tracks an issue or service request that needs resolution. A customer can therefore be associated with several related records that describe different work, rather than being copied into unrelated 'Customer One' and 'Customer Two' objects.

03 · Follow Irina without forcing a conversion story

Irina asks about a City EV. Northstar might initially capture that enquiry as a Lead if its sales process qualifies enquiries that way. When it identifies a real sales opportunity, the team may maintain a Contact for Irina and an Opportunity for the possible purchase. A Lead is not required before every Opportunity: a salesperson can create an Opportunity for an existing relationship. Lead conversion is one supported process, not the definition of all selling. After purchase, Irina reports a problem with a charging cable. That issue is a Case, not a new Opportunity merely because it concerns the same person. If she later considers another vehicle, a separate Opportunity can describe that new potential sale. The records represent different events and responsibilities even though they concern one customer.

02 · Give every field a clear responsibility

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «Give every field a clear responsibility». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

Northstar's starter stores Scheduled_At__c as a date and time, and Status__c as a restricted picklist. A date and time describes an instant; a status describes progress. Making both text fields would accept vague values such as 'sometime later' or inconsistent spellings that are difficult to process. A field type defines what sort of information can be stored, but it does not by itself express every business rule. We will add an optional teaching extension: Duration_Minutes__c, a Number field with three digits and zero decimal places. It is not present in the core starter. Add it deliberately and include it in your submitted metadata. For the exercise, Oleg agrees that entered durations must be between 15 and 120 minutes. This is a classroom requirement, not a general rule about Salesforce or dealerships.

03 · Calculate one value and reject a different problem

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «Calculate one value and reject a different problem». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

Create a Date/Time formula field named Planned_End__c. Its value is Scheduled_At__c plus Duration_Minutes__c divided by 1440, the number of minutes in a day. A formula field is calculated rather than edited directly. Guard against missing inputs so that a partial request does not display a misleading end time. Display behaviour follows the user's time settings; test with an explicit time zone in your evidence. A validation rule rejects a save when its error-condition formula evaluates to true. That direction matters: the formula describes the invalid case. We will reject a newly entered or changed scheduled time that is in the past. We will not block an unrelated update to an old appointment merely because its original appointment time has now passed.

02 · A connection also carries behaviour

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «A connection also carries behaviour». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

A relationship is more than a line on a diagram. It affects how records depend on one another and what happens when a related record changes or is deleted. Salesforce supports different relationship types. For this lesson, compare Lookup with Master-Detail. Do not choose between them only because both can display a related record on a page. A Lookup connects a record to another record while allowing a comparatively independent design. The exact requiredness and deletion behaviour depend on the field configuration and supported object combination. A Master-Detail relationship creates a stronger dependency: the detail's ownership and record access follow the master, and deleting the master also deletes its detail records. Inspect the actual configuration rather than treating all lookups as identical.

03 · Read the course relationship as a contract

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «Read the course relationship as a contract». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

The core Test_Drive__c.Vehicle__c field is an optional Lookup to Vehicle__c with SetNull deletion behaviour. Test_Drive__c.Customer__c is an optional Lookup to Contact with the same deletion setting. The Test Drive object has its own owner and Private organization-wide default. Those are deliberate starter choices that allow us to teach separate appointment ownership and sharing in J11–J16. Suppose Anna owns an appointment for a vehicle managed by another employee. A Lookup does not automatically mean every person who can see the vehicle can see Anna's appointment. Equally, the appointment's independent sharing does not grant permission to every field on the related Contact. These access questions must be designed and tested separately.

02 · Design for a task rather than a catalogue of fields

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «Design for a task rather than a catalogue of fields». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

Anna needs to find a vehicle, identify a customer, and record an appointment. A useful application makes that sequence understandable. Putting every available field on the screen does not automatically make the application complete. Start with the agreed task from J06 and the data model from J07–J09. The starter defines objects and fields, but it does not provide a finished Northstar application. Create custom object tabs for Vehicle and Test Drive if they are not already available, then use App Manager to create a Lightning application named Northstar Learning. Add the navigation items required by the task, such as Vehicles, Test Drives, and Contacts. Availability still depends on permissions; an application is not an access-control shortcut.

03 · Distinguish the page from the stored information

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «Distinguish the page from the stored information». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

A page layout arranges fields and actions for a record. A Lightning record page arranges components around that record. These configuration layers affect presentation. Field-level security controls access to a field. Removing a field from a layout is not a substitute for denying access, because another supported entry route may still expose an accessible field. The course Test Drive has an automatically generated Name, displayed as a number such as TD-0001. Anna should not be expected to type that number. Place Vehicle, Customer, Scheduled At, and Status where she can understand them. If you added the duration extension in J08, explain it alongside the calculated end rather than presenting the formula as another editable input.

02 · Describe the requested action

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «Describe the requested action». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

Oleg says that Max should see tomorrow's test drive. Before configuring anything, make that sentence precise. Max needs to sign in, read Test Drive records, read the relevant fields, and access the particular appointment. If he must change its time, the required action is different. Access without a user, record, field, and operation is too vague to test. Organization access concerns entry into the environment, including an active account and applicable login controls. Object permissions describe operations such as Create, Read, Edit, and Delete on a category of data; people often abbreviate these as CRUD. Field-level security, or FLS, describes which fields are readable or editable. Record access concerns the individual records a user can reach within those object operations.

03 · Distinguish similar symptoms

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «Distinguish similar symptoms». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

Imagine that Anna owns TD-001 and Max does not. First, Max cannot sign in. Sharing TD-001 does not repair the login problem. Second, Max can sign in but lacks Read on Test Drive. A record share does not substitute for object Read. Third, he can read the appointment but not a protected field. Increasing record sharing does not fix a deliberately restricted field. Fourth, Max has the relevant object and field permissions but no access to the private appointment. This is the situation where record-sharing mechanisms become relevant. This sequence is a useful model for ordinary interactions, not a claim that every execution context is identical. Developer features, elevated permissions, and specialized access controls need explicit consideration in later lessons.

Organization-wide defaults, commonly called OWD, define a baseline for access to records users do not own. The course starter sets Vehicle and Test Drive to Private. Ownership identifies the responsible owner of a record. Sharing can add access for another recipient without changing that owner. Anna can remain the owner while Max receives access. Transferring ownership changes a different relationship and may alter other access paths as well. Do not memorize the outdated absolute statement that manual shares always disappear after transfer. Current Salesforce documentation describes an org-level setting named Keep manual shares when transferring records. The default behaviour removes manual shares when ownership changes; enabling the setting changes that behaviour. Inspect and record the actual setting before predicting your result.

02 · Write a reproducible access report

Anna reports that Max cannot see an appointment. Begin by asking which user, which record, which fields, and which action. Record the route through the application and the exact visible result. 'Missing from Recently Viewed' and 'access denied when opening a known record' are different observations. The first may concern a list; the second is stronger evidence about record access. Use fictional records and private identifiers in the investigation note. Include the time of the check and the configuration changes that occurred shortly before it. A problem that started after a permission-set assignment is a useful clue, but timing alone does not prove the cause. Treat it as a hypothesis to investigate.

03 · Inspect grants before adding them

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «Inspect grants before adding them». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

Open the relevant user in Setup and inspect View Summary where available. The User Access Summary consolidates useful permission and assignment information. Access Granted By can show which profile, permission set, or permission set group supplies a particular permission. Refresh the summary after assignment changes and remember that not every possible access feature is represented in one screen. For missing object Read, inspect all object grants. For a field issue, inspect field permissions and the page configuration separately. For a record issue, inspect ownership, OWD, hierarchy settings, group memberships, sharing rules, manual shares, and broad record-access permissions. The checklist narrows the cause; it does not justify changing every item.

02 · Define the personas before configuring them

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «Define the personas before configuring them». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

A persona is a description of a type of user and the work that user needs to perform. It is not automatically a Salesforce profile, role, or permission set. For this capstone, Anna represents sales work, Max represents service preparation for the exercise, and Oleg represents management. Max is normally another salesperson in the story; assigning him a temporary service-review responsibility here is an explicit test scenario. Anna should create and manage the appointments she owns. The service reviewer should read Confirmed appointments needed for preparation, without changing appointment data. Oleg should read the appointments covered by the agreed management hierarchy. Do not assume Oleg should edit every record merely because he is a manager. Write the requirement and configure only what it needs.

03 · Create an executable matrix

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «Create an executable matrix». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

Make a matrix whose rows are actions and whose columns are personas. Use concrete records: Anna's Requested appointment, Anna's Confirmed appointment, and an unrelated peer appointment where suitable users exist. Include read, edit, and delete actions, plus at least one field-level restriction. Mark the expected result and the reason for it. For example, the service reviewer may read Anna's Confirmed appointment through the focused sharing rule but should not edit its scheduled time because object Edit is absent. Anna may edit her own appointment but should not gain broad vehicle deletion. Oleg's visibility must be explained through the actual role positions and custom-object hierarchy setting, not through an administrator profile.

A Flow is a configured sequence of operations. A record-triggered Flow starts when an eligible record is created, updated, or deleted, according to its configuration. Our requirement is deliberately small: when a new Requested Test Drive with a scheduled time is created, create one Task for its owner to follow up. A Task is a Salesforce work item. Creating it is not the same as sending an email or displaying a timed desktop reminder. Choose an after-save record-triggered Flow because it creates a separate related record. A before-save flow is useful for certain changes to the triggering record itself, but that is not this action. Limiting the trigger to record creation prevents an ordinary later edit from creating another Task. This is a specific duplicate-prevention design, not a universal guarantee against duplicate source appointments.

02 · Read the language one construct at a time

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «Read the language one construct at a time». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

Apex is a programming language used on the Salesforce platform. A variable names a value, and its type describes what kind of value it can hold. Integer represents a whole number, String represents text, and Boolean represents true or false. An assignment such as Integer minute = 600 stores a value. A comparison such as minute == 600 asks a question; the two operations are different. A class groups related code. A method is a named operation with inputs, a return type, and a body between braces. public makes the method available to callers allowed by the language; static lets it be called on the class without creating an instance. return supplies the result. An if statement chooses a branch, and a for loop repeats a block for elements in a collection. Semicolons finish statements, while braces group their bodies.

03 · Choose a collection for a purpose

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «Choose a collection for a purpose». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

A List keeps elements in an indexed sequence and can contain duplicates. A Set keeps unique elements without promising a useful display order. A Map connects unique keys to values, such as an appointment ID to a prepared label. These choices express different needs; replacing every list with a map does not automatically make code better. Our example uses minutes after midnight as a simple integer exercise. 600 means 10:00 and 840 means 14:00. This is not a complete scheduling model: it has no date, time zone, duration, or vehicle. The function removes occupied values, ignores invalid or missing numbers, removes duplicates, and returns the remaining minutes in ascending order. Those decisions are explicit parts of its contract.

02 · A query reads; DML changes stored records

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «A query reads; DML changes stored records». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

SOQL, the Salesforce Object Query Language, selects records and fields. DML, or Data Manipulation Language, creates, updates, deletes, or otherwise changes records. Reading a Test Drive into an Apex variable does not itself change the stored appointment. Assigning a different value to that variable also does not persist it until an appropriate DML operation succeeds. Oleg asks for a small function that cancels Requested appointments for a supplied set of vehicles. The caller supplies vehicle IDs, which identify records. The method should ignore an empty input, query eligible appointments once, prepare the changes, and update the collection once. It must not cancel Confirmed appointments merely because they concern the same vehicle.

03 · Make access mode explicit

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «Make access mode explicit». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

The example deliberately uses WITH USER_MODE for the query and update as user for DML. This makes the intended access mode visible instead of relying on version-sensitive defaults. The project targets API 68.0. Current documentation differs from older material about defaults, so use explicit modes and inspect the documentation version when maintaining older code. User-mode operations enforce applicable user access, including object and field permissions and record-sharing behaviour. The fields used in query conditions matter too. A class declared with sharing is not, by itself, a complete statement that every object and field operation has been authorized. Keep class sharing and database-operation access mode conceptually separate.

02 · Understand what starts a trigger

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «Understand what starts a trigger». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

An Apex trigger runs in response to specified database events, such as inserting or updating records. Before triggers run before the final stored result is established and can be useful for checking or changing incoming values. After triggers serve different needs, including work that relies on saved identifiers. Choose the event from the requirement rather than using after update for every problem. Oleg agrees two small rules for this lesson. A Confirmed appointment must identify its vehicle, customer, and scheduled time. An existing Completed appointment must not change status. This is not a complete scheduling state machine: it does not check calendar overlap or guarantee that every possible business transition is covered. Those limits are explicit.

03 · Read old and new values for the whole collection

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «Read old and new values for the whole collection». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

Trigger.new contains the incoming records for supported events. Trigger.oldMap provides previous records keyed by ID for update scenarios. Comparing old and new values lets the handler distinguish an actual transition from an unrelated edit. Repeating the same Completed status is not a change and should not be rejected by the terminal-status rule. The handler loops over every incoming record, not only the first. addError marks an invalid record with an explanation. Whether a caller permits partial success affects the overall save result; the normal all-or-none DML statement can fail the group. Do not claim that addError always produces exactly the same batch outcome regardless of the calling operation.

02 · A user action can start more than one operation

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «A user action can start more than one operation». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

Anna edits an appointment once, but the platform may run validation, before-save automation, triggers, and after-save automation as part of processing that change. A transaction is a unit of database work with a commit or rollback outcome. Commit makes successful changes durable; rollback reverses the transaction changes covered by that rollback. Use the official order-of-execution reference for the API and release you are working with. Do not memorize an old infographic as timeless truth. For this lesson, follow the relevant segments: before-save record-triggered Flow, before triggers, custom validation, later trigger and after-save automation stages, and the eventual commit. This is a focused route through the official sequence, not a complete replacement for it.

03 · Predict interactions in the Northstar project

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «Predict interactions in the Northstar project». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

Suppose the J20 handler rejects an incomplete Confirmed appointment. The fact that Anna clicked the final button does not mean the record committed before that rejection. Likewise, the J17 Flow may attempt to create a follow-up Task and reach its Custom Error fault route. In that designed failure case, the source save is rejected rather than leaving a valid appointment with a silently missing required Task. Two automations can also affect one another. An after-save action that updates its triggering record can cause another save cycle. A condition that remains true on every edit may repeat work. Prefer an event and change condition tied to the requirement. Do not reach immediately for a global static Boolean; a blanket skip can hide legitimate records or later processing.

02 · A test is a claim with executable evidence

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «A test is a claim with executable evidence». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

A useful test states what should happen for known inputs and checks the result. Code coverage measures which executable lines ran; it does not prove the business rule was correct. A test that calls a method without assertions can execute many lines while allowing a wrong result to pass unnoticed. Start with a pure function from J18. A deterministic input and expected output make the purpose clear. Then test the record behaviour from J20 with synthetic data created by the test. Avoid depending on ordinary records already present in the org. An isolated test should explain its own setup and survive changes to unrelated sample data.

03 · Separate setup, execution, and assertions

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «Separate setup, execution, and assertions». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

An Apex test method is marked @IsTest. The test creates its inputs, performs the operation, and checks the result with assertions. Test.startTest and Test.stopTest delimit the operation under test and provide the documented testing behaviour for limits and asynchronous work. They do not turn a weak assertion into a strong one. For the trigger tests, create a Vehicle with a Name, Model, and appropriate Status, and a fictional Contact with LastName. Create Test Drive records using those IDs and a future Scheduled_At__c. Use Confirmed when testing a valid confirmation, so the create-only Requested reminder Flow is not accidentally the central subject of that particular test. Test the Flow interaction separately.

02 · Understand markup and behaviour separately

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «Understand markup and behaviour separately». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

HTML describes the structure of a web interface. A paragraph uses a p element; a list can use ul and li elements. Elements have opening and closing tags, and attributes describe additional information. A Lightning Web Component, or LWC, combines an HTML template with JavaScript behaviour and a metadata configuration file. It is not an Apex class running in the browser. JavaScript stores values and responds to events in the browser. A string is text, an array is an ordered collection written with square brackets, and an object groups named values inside braces. The sample row { id: 'demo-1', label: 'City EV appointment' } is an object in browser memory. It is not automatically a saved Salesforce record. The strict equality operator === compares values without the same coercion behaviour as loose equality.

03 · Read the component contract

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «Read the component contract». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

import loads a named capability from another JavaScript module. The class extends LightningElement so it can participate in the LWC framework. A property such as state stores the current display state. A method such as showSample runs when its button is clicked. A getter, written with get, derives a value from current properties without being called with parentheses in the template. The template uses curly-brace bindings such as {isLoading} to read JavaScript properties. lwc:if, lwc:elseif, and lwc:else select the visible branch. Keep the branches adjacent. The list directive repeats markup for each row, and key supplies a stable identity for each rendered item. Do not use an array position as the meaningful identity of a changing business record.

02 · Choose the smallest useful data component

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «Choose the smallest useful data component». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

The preview from J23 contained only browser data. Anna now needs to edit the scheduled time and status of a real Test Drive record that she can access. For a standard record-editing task, begin with Salesforce base components backed by Lightning Data Service rather than immediately writing a custom Apex controller. Lightning Data Service, often abbreviated LDS, supports record access for these components and works with the platform's permission model. The standard record form can display and edit selected fields, handle a normal save, and show supported errors. This reduces code you would otherwise need to write and maintain. It does not mean the application no longer needs testing or a correct underlying sharing design.

03 · Use the current record context

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «Use the current record context». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

A record page has a current record. The public recordId property receives that context when the component is placed in a supported record-page environment. The @api decorator marks the property as part of the component's public interface. It does not magically supply an ID in every possible container. A component on an ordinary App Page needs a different, explicit way to identify a record. The JavaScript imports object and field references from the Salesforce schema. These imports make the intended metadata dependencies visible. The fields array contains only Scheduled At and Status for this task, not every field in the object. The form uses mode edit and provides its own standard save and cancel behaviour.

02 · Give each component a responsibility

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «Give each component a responsibility». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

A component can become difficult to understand when it owns a list, renders every row, edits a record, and coordinates unrelated behaviour. Splitting it helps only when the responsibilities become clearer. For this exercise, appointmentPicker owns a small simulated list and the selected identifier. appointmentChoice displays one item and announces that the user selected it. A public @api property lets the parent supply data to the child. The child should treat an object supplied by its owner as read-only. If it wants a change, it should communicate an intent rather than secretly altering the parent's object. This makes the direction of state ownership visible and makes later bugs easier to trace.

03 · Use a small event contract

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «Use a small event contract». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

A CustomEvent communicates something that happened. Its type is a string agreed between sender and listener. In this example the type is selectappointment, and the detail is just the selected identifier. Sending a primitive identifier avoids exposing a mutable object when the parent only needs to know which item was chosen. The child dispatches the event from itself. The parent listens directly on the child element with onselectappointment. The default non-bubbling, non-composed behaviour is sufficient for this direct relationship. Do not set every event to bubble across boundaries merely because it seems easier; a broader event contract exposes behaviour to more consumers.

Git records versions of files. Salesforce stores the active configuration and business records in an org. These are related but not automatically identical. A working field created in Setup will not appear in a local repository until the relevant metadata is retrieved. A local code edit will not run in the org until it is deployed successfully. Metadata describes configuration and code: objects, fields, permission sets, Flow definitions, components, and other supported types. Business records are the customers and appointments stored using that configuration. A normal metadata deployment does not automatically recreate all of your synthetic test records. The handover therefore needs both a metadata plan and a sample-data setup explanation.

Keep your solution work in your own repository rather than opening a solution PR into the course curriculum. A branch is a separate line of file changes. A commit is a recorded snapshot with a message. A pull request asks a reviewer to inspect the proposed difference between branches. Create a small branch for the assignment, inspect git status, and review git diff before staging files. Stage the intended paths rather than blindly adding every file in the workspace.

02 · Understand the mechanism

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «Understand the mechanism». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

Northstar Motors has two salespeople, Anna and Max, and a manager, Oleg. Irina is their customer, represented by a Contact record; she is not automatically a Salesforce user. Saying that service staff should see customers leaves several questions unanswered. Which customers, which fields, through which interface, and what may staff change? An access model answers these questions before a profile or sharing rule is edited. Separate four decisions. Object permission determines whether an operation such as reading Test Drive is available at all. Field-level security determines which fields the person may read or edit. Record access determines which individual test drives the person can reach. A business rule can further decide whether an otherwise editable appointment may be cancelled. A person passing one layer has not automatically passed the others.

02 · Understand the mechanism

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «Understand the mechanism». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

A permission set is a reusable bundle of grants. A permission set group combines several bundles for a working persona, such as Northstar sales coordinator. Muting adjusts permissions contributed by that particular group. It does not place a universal deny on the user, and it does not rewrite the original permission set that another group may reuse. Imagine a VIN Maintenance permission set that grants Edit on Vehicle__c.VIN__c. The Data Steward group needs the grant. The Sales Coordinator group also includes this reusable permission set but mutes VIN editing. A user receiving only the coordinator group should not gain that edit permission through it. If the same user also receives VIN Maintenance directly, the independent grant remains.

Anna receives Sales Coordinator, whose muting permission set removes VIN Edit. Max receives Data Steward. Anna should read a visible vehicle's VIN without editing it; Max may edit the synthetic VIN if the remaining object and record permissions permit it. Now assign VIN Maintenance directly to Anna. Predict her edit access before testing. It returns because a different assignment path supplies it. Remove the direct assignment and add a second group granting the same field permission. The result should again demonstrate an independent path. Keep record access constant throughout these experiments: changing both sharing and FLS would make the cause ambiguous.

02 · Understand the mechanism

Manual sharing is a deliberate record-level grant to another user or group. It can solve a small exception such as Anna asking Max to help with one appointment. It does not grant object Read or field permissions. An owner may give a record-level permission that Max cannot effectively use until the other security layers allow the operation. Implicit sharing describes access Salesforce derives from particular supported relationships and ownership rules, especially around Account and related standard records. It is platform-managed behavior, not a generic consequence of any lookup. The exact result depends on the objects and sharing configuration. Explain the documented relationship involved rather than claiming that every parent automatically shares all children.

RowCause is the reason for the grant; it lets your process distinguish its work from Manual, Owner, or another application's reason.

02 · Understand the mechanism

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «Understand the mechanism». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

A sharing mechanism opens access to records. A restriction rule narrows the records a matching user can access through supported paths. Think of two stages: first determine the records available from the ordinary security model, then apply the rule's record criteria where the feature is supported. A restriction rule does not give a user object Read or open a private appointment. Rules have user criteria and record criteria. User criteria identify the people to whom the restriction applies; record criteria identify the records that remain visible to those people. Both must be stated explicitly. A rule that accidentally matches Oleg as well as Anna can hide operational work from the manager, even when the sharing design itself is correct.

Apex security questions become easier when you name two separate decisions. The class sharing declaration describes record-sharing behavior in the relevant execution context. A database operation's access mode determines whether it enforces user-level permissions or deliberately runs with elevated behavior. Saying only 'this class is with sharing' does not explain every field or object check. Defaults are versioned. In API 67.0 and later, classes without an explicit sharing declaration default to with sharing, and database operations default to user mode. In older versions, omission of a sharing declaration preserves the current sharing context rather than being a synonym for an explicit without sharing declaration; older database operations default to system mode. Read the current reference when migrating an existing class.

Northstar wants an automatic follow-up when Irina's test drive is confirmed. A Flow can be a clear choice when the rule is straightforward, administrators maintain it, and existing automation remains understandable. A more complex allocation algorithm or a highly reused typed service may fit Apex better. Neither the number of clicks nor a developer's preferred tool is a sufficient decision rule. Start with the business operation, not the technology. State what triggers it, which records it reads and writes, the expected batch size, who maintains it, and what should happen when one record fails. Then locate the transaction boundary: must the follow-up succeed together with the confirmation, or may it be processed later? Moving work asynchronously changes the product's failure behavior, even if it reduces synchronous work.

02 · Understand the mechanism

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «Understand the mechanism». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

A Salesforce save can run several layers of validation and automation. Some automation changes the same or related records, causing additional processing. Order of execution is the documented sequence of these stages; it is not simply 'Flow always before Apex' or 'one click means one trigger execution.' Use the current sequence and your actual configured automation when investigating a repeated effect. Recursion is re-entry into a process caused by its own or related changes. Idempotency is a different property: repeating the same business operation does not create an additional business result. A recursion guard can reduce repeated work inside one transaction while doing nothing against a later API retry, a second Queueable transaction, or another user's concurrent request.

03 · Northstar Motors worked example

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «Northstar Motors worked example». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

Anna confirms TD-A. A Flow updates another field, and a trigger sees the appointment again. Max then resubmits the same external request after his client times out. A static guard might suppress the second trigger pass in Anna's transaction, but it cannot recognize Max's later request. 🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «Understand the mechanism». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

A large warranty method often mixes several jobs: reading a vehicle, deciding whether to request a check, constructing HTTP, interpreting a response, saving status, and deciding retry timing. When one policy changes, this mixture makes unrelated behavior harder to understand. Separation is useful when each part has a distinct reason to change and a clear input/output contract. For Northstar, use three responsibilities. A policy object describes allowed attempts and timeout. A client adapter translates the warranty provider's request and response. An application service coordinates the vehicle, request state, and chosen client. This is a responsibility map, not a requirement to create an interface for every helper or a framework before the first use case works.

Suppose the provider changes its JSON from covered to isCovered. That translation belongs in the adapter. If Oleg changes the allowed retry count from three to two, policy changes without rewriting HTTP parsing. If Northstar decides that a completed test drive must exist before requesting a warranty check, that eligibility rule belongs in the application behavior, not in the generic HTTP client. For the first implementation, avoid the network entirely. Create a small policy class with constructor arguments enabled, maxAttempts, and timeoutMillis. Have the orchestration accept the policy as input. The production entry point reads Custom Metadata and constructs the policy; unit tests construct explicit values. This keeps the local rule testable without pretending configuration and endpoint authentication were verified.

A useful unit test states a rule in executable form. It prepares known inputs, performs one operation, and checks a meaningful observable result. Code coverage tells you which lines ran; it does not tell you whether a completed appointment was accidentally cancelled or whether the returned value was correct. The strongest test fails when the behavior it protects is broken. Northstar's local rule cancels Requested or Confirmed appointments strictly earlier than a supplied cutoff. Completed, Cancelled, and future appointments remain unchanged. Supplying the cutoff makes the rule deterministic; a test does not depend on the wall clock reaching midnight or on a record that happens to exist in the org. The boundary at exactly the cutoff deserves its own assertion.

Use a cutoff of 2030-04-10 12:00 UTC. Create four appointments: Requested at 11:59, Confirmed at 12:00, Completed at 11:00, and Requested at 12:01. The first should become Cancelled, while the others retain their status. These exact examples distinguish a strict-before rule from an accidental less-than-or-equal comparison. After your tests pass, temporarily change the comparison to include equality. Run the same suite. The boundary test should fail. Restore the implementation and rerun. This controlled mutation demonstrates that the assertion protects the intended rule rather than simply following the implementation's current output.

02 · Understand the mechanism

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «Understand the mechanism». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

Synchronous work runs as part of the operation the user is waiting for. Asynchronous work is accepted for later processing in another execution context. Moving work out of the save can improve responsiveness, but the user now needs a way to learn whether it succeeded. A message saying 'request accepted' is different from 'warranty verified.' Queueable Apex suits a defined background unit that can carry serializable inputs and expose a job identity. Batch Apex partitions a larger selected dataset into separate execute transactions. Scheduled Apex or a scheduled Flow starts work according to a schedule; scheduling does not transform an unlimited amount of processing into a safe single transaction. An asynchronous Flow path can handle appropriate declarative follow-up work after the original save.

02 · Understand the mechanism

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «Understand the mechanism». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

Batch Apex separates selection from processing. The start method defines the dataset, execute receives a scope of records, and finish performs final coordination. Each execute invocation is a separate transaction with its own applicable limits. The job is therefore not one atomic transaction: a failure in a later scope does not automatically undo records committed by an earlier successful scope. Scope size is a workload decision. Smaller scopes can reduce work and failure impact per transaction but increase transaction overhead. Larger scopes can be efficient until queries, writes, CPU, heap, or downstream automation make them unsafe. Estimate those costs from the actual operation rather than selecting 200 because it appears in an example. A scope also does not guarantee the order in which records are processed.

For unit tests, keep each batch invocation's selected dataset within one execute scope. 02 · Understand the mechanism

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «Understand the mechanism». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

A schedule decides when work should be requested. It does not guarantee that a long job finishes before the next scheduled occurrence, and it does not remove transaction or org limits. Northstar's nightly cancellation process therefore needs both a calendar rule and an execution policy. 'Run every night' is incomplete without a time zone, cutoff definition, and response to a missed or still-running job. Scheduled Apex implements Schedulable; its execute method typically starts a bounded service or Batch. A scheduled Flow can be appropriate for declarative recurring processing. Choose from the required selection, volume, maintenance, and error behavior rather than assuming the scheduling mechanism performs the entire workload. Review the execution context and access of the work it launches.

03 · Northstar Motors worked example

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «Northstar Motors worked example». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

Northstar processes appointments before midnight in its agreed business time zone. The 01:00 run selects that fixed cutoff and normally takes ten minutes. On a busy day it is still active when an operator requests a manual rerun. Choose either to reject the duplicate launch with an observable reason or to resume a defined unprocessed partition. Do not let both workers silently process the same set. Create Processing_Run__c only if implementing durable coordination: Auto Number Name, Run_Key__c Text(80) Unique External ID, Status__c Picklist Running/Succeeded/Failed, Started_At__c and Finished_At__c DateTime, and Summary__c Text(255). Use a key such as 'cancel:2030-04-10'. These are new fields. A failed run requires an authorized recovery transition, not deletion of evidence.

02 · Understand the mechanism

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «Understand the mechanism». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

An API contract states how two systems communicate. For Northstar's warranty check, it should specify the method and path, VIN format, response fields, error meanings, authentication, timeout expectations, and retry rules. A successful sample call is only one observation. It does not establish the contract for missing vehicles, expired credentials, malformed responses, or repeated operations. HTTP is a request-and-response protocol. A method says what kind of operation is requested: GET reads information, while a service may use POST to accept an operation. A URL identifies the destination; headers carry metadata; a body carries structured content. The response includes a numeric status and may include a body. JSON represents named values using braces, quoted property names, strings, numbers, Boolean values, arrays, and null. In the sample, covered is a Boolean, not the string "true". The exact meaning of each status and field belongs in the service contract.

02 · Understand the mechanism

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «Understand the mechanism». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

REST and SOAP are integration styles with different contract shapes. A REST warranty API might expose a resource path and JSON representation. A SOAP service exposes named operations with typed XML messages described by WSDL. The choice is often already made by the provider. Replacing a supported SOAP operation with an imagined REST endpoint is not an implementation decision available to the caller. XML uses matching opening and closing tags to name structured values; an xmlns declaration identifies a namespace so similarly named elements can be distinguished. WSDL is an XML contract describing operations, message structures, and service bindings. Reading the illustrative body below does not require writing a WSDL from scratch. In the linked official example, follow its actual generated class definitions before running its mock test.

02 · Understand the mechanism

A callout is a request from Apex to an external HTTP endpoint. Its result has several layers: the transport may fail, the server may return an error status, the body may violate the expected schema, or the body may contain a valid negative business answer. Collapsing all four into 'not covered' would mislead Anna and hide integration failures. Use a small result contract such as COVERED, NOT_COVERED, NOT_FOUND, RETRYABLE, INVALID_RESPONSE, and TRANSPORT_ERROR. A 429 or selected 5xx response may justify a bounded later retry. A malformed 200 response should be diagnosed as a contract problem. A transport exception does not prove the provider did nothing; for state-changing requests, an unknown remote outcome requires reconciliation rather than a blind retry.

02 · Understand the mechanism

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «Understand the mechanism». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

An external ID identifies a Salesforce record using a key from another system. It lets an integration find or upsert the same record without first knowing its Salesforce Id. Upsert means create when there is no matching record and update when there is one. It is useful for synchronization, but it does not by itself make every downstream side effect exactly once. An idempotency key identifies a business operation. The same request repeated after a timeout should return the existing result or safely continue that operation. The key must have a defined scope and payload meaning. Reusing WARRANTY-100 for a different vehicle should be a conflict, not a quiet overwrite of the original customer's request.

02 · Understand the mechanism

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «Understand the mechanism». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

When Anna says that a warranty check failed, a developer needs to locate one business request and follow its attempts. A correlation ID connects diagnostic events belonging to the same operation. The request key from M12 can serve this role within the exercise. Each retry additionally has an attempt number and potentially a new Queueable job ID. These values answer different questions and should not replace one another. A useful diagnostic event records what stage was reached, when it happened, the outcome category, and a safe error code. It need not contain the full request body, customer details, credentials, or raw provider response. Log enough to distinguish a malformed response from an expired credential or rejected business input, while keeping sensitive data out of routine evidence.

02 · Understand the mechanism

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «Understand the mechanism». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

SOQL queries records from a known object using structured fields and filters. It suits a request such as 'show Confirmed test drives scheduled tomorrow.' SOSL searches text across supported searchable fields and can return results from multiple object types. It suits 'find the customer named Irina across Contact, Lead, and Account.' The decision starts with the question, not with which language has fewer characters. A child-to-parent SOQL relationship traverses a lookup using its relationship name. In the starter, Test_Drive__c.Customer__c points to Contact and Vehicle__c points to Vehicle__c, so expressions such as Customer__r.Name and Vehicle__r.Model__c provide related fields. These optional lookups may be null; the UI should not assume every row has a parent record.
