02 · Understand the mechanism

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «Understand the mechanism». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

LWC manages component instances. A lifecycle hook is a method the framework calls at a particular stage, such as construction, connection to the document, rendering, or disconnection. The lifecycle concerns the instance, not a single Salesforce record save. A component may render many times as its state or inputs change, and an attached instance may later be removed and reinserted. Use constructor for minimal initialization after super, not for querying child elements. connectedCallback is a place to begin work that requires attachment, but it can run again if the instance is reinserted. renderedCallback runs after rendering and can run repeatedly; changing reactive data there can schedule another render and create a loop. disconnectedCallback is where owned external resources often need cleanup.

An @api property is part of a component's public input contract. A parent can pass the selected appointment ID, and the child should respond to changes without mutating the parent's object. @wire provisions data reactively from an adapter or cacheable Apex method. An imperative Apex call runs when your code explicitly invokes it, making it appropriate for a user-requested write. A JavaScript Promise represents an operation that will settle later as fulfilled or rejected. An async method returns a Promise; await pauses that method’s continuation until the supplied Promise settles, without freezing the whole page. try/catch handles rejection from an awaited operation. This is why the save and refresh below have separate try blocks. A reactive wire parameter uses a dollar-prefixed property reference, such as status: "$status", so changing the component property requests data for the new input.

02 · Understand the mechanism

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «Understand the mechanism». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

A child component should not reach into its parent's internal state. It can receive input through @api and announce an interaction through a DOM CustomEvent. The parent handles that event and decides what to do. This makes the child reusable: a visit row can announce a selected record without knowing whether the parent opens a panel, navigates, or updates a filter. Lightning Message Service communicates across supported component regions in a Lightning page or application. It can connect components without a convenient common parent, including supported Aura or Visualforce integration points. A message channel defines the shared contract. LMS is a client-side application communication mechanism, not the server event bus used by Platform Events.

An accessible component communicates state and supports operation without relying only on a mouse or color. A spinner needs meaningful context, an error needs understandable text, and a selectable row needs a keyboard-operable control. Use appropriate Lightning base components and semantic HTML before inventing custom interaction patterns. A visually attractive card can still be unusable when focus disappears after an update. Jest runs LWC unit tests locally. The tests create a component instance, supply controlled inputs or mocks, perform an interaction, and assert rendered output or dispatched events. They do not deploy to Salesforce or verify live object permissions. Mocking a successful Apex response does not prove that the actual Apex method returns that response for a restricted user.

02 · Understand the mechanism

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «Understand the mechanism». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

Shadow DOM defines an encapsulated internal tree for a component. The component's markup is not a public collection of elements for unrelated code to manipulate. LWC's platform implementation can differ between supported rendering modes and releases, but the design principle remains: interact through public properties, methods, events, and supported styling mechanisms rather than depending on another component's private DOM. Within a shadow-rendered LWC, this.template.querySelector accesses elements owned by that component. A document-level selector is not the correct way to find a child's private input. Timing matters too: an element may not exist before rendering or while a conditional template branch is absent. A null query result can be expected state, not a reason to bypass encapsulation.

02 · Understand the mechanism

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «Understand the mechanism». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

A Platform Event is a message on Salesforce's event infrastructure. A producer publishes it, and subscribers react independently. 'Test drive confirmed' describes a business fact; 'confirm this test drive' requests an action. Naming the intent matters because a subscriber should know whether it can trust the referenced change as committed or is being asked to perform it. Publish After Commit ties publication to successful completion of the producing transaction. This is a natural choice for a message announcing a saved confirmation. Publish Immediately decouples publication from the transaction's final outcome, so a subscriber may observe the event before related data commits or even when the producer later rolls back. That behavior can be useful for specific diagnostics but is not interchangeable with a committed business fact.

02 · Understand the mechanism

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «Understand the mechanism». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

Change Data Capture describes supported changes to Salesforce records. A custom Platform Event describes a business message chosen by your application. If a downstream system needs a replica of selected record changes, CDC may fit. If it needs the explicit fact that a test drive confirmation was accepted under a particular rule, a custom business event can provide a clearer contract than interpreting every field update. Replay lets a subscriber resume from a previously recorded position within the available event retention window. The replay ID is a stream position token, not a VIN, request ID, or universal permanent event identity. Do not generate it, increment it, or assume it is a consecutive sequence. Store the value supplied by the platform using the subscription mechanism's documented format.

02 · Understand the mechanism

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «Understand the mechanism». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

The working tree contains the files currently checked out. The index, often called staging, records the content prepared for the next commit. A local branch points to a commit in your repository. A remote-tracking reference such as origin/main records the last fetched state of the remote branch; it is not a live view that updates itself whenever someone pushes. git fetch downloads objects and updates the relevant remote-tracking references without automatically integrating them into your current branch. git pull performs a fetch followed by an integration strategy, such as merge or rebase, according to options and configuration. Before pulling, know which branch you are on, whether the working tree is clean, and which integration behavior is intended.

A feature can have passing unit tests in every layer while its combined path fails. The LWC may submit the wrong key, the service may enqueue work twice, or the worker may save a result that the UI never reloads. End-to-end verification follows the actual user intention across boundaries and checks the final business state, not merely each method's isolated return value. For Northstar, the path is Anna's request, authorized vehicle lookup, durable warranty request, background attempt, provider classification, persisted outcome, and visible UI state. The provider can remain mocked for the required course exercise. Clearly label that boundary: the test verifies your application against controlled responses, not real provider authentication, network behavior, or production throughput.

A Case records a customer's service issue. A queue groups work that a team can handle. An assignment rule can place a Case with an owner or queue, but that is not the same as deciding which available employee should receive the next item. Omni-Channel adds routing behavior based on configured eligibility, workload, priority, and, when used, skills. Presence describes whether a person is available for the relevant work. Capacity describes how much work the configuration allows them to handle. A work item consumes capacity according to the chosen model. Queue membership alone does not prove that a person is currently eligible: they may be offline, at capacity, missing a needed skill, or unavailable for the relevant service channel.

The core SAM project uses Vehicle__c to teach Salesforce development with a small owned schema. That custom object is not the Automotive Cloud Vehicle standard object, and deploying the starter does not install the industry product. Similar labels can conceal different APIs, relationships, licenses, and business capabilities. Keep the two models visibly separate. Automotive Cloud's Vehicle Definition extends product information with model-level vehicle characteristics, such as dimensions or powertrain specifications. An individual Vehicle represents a particular vehicle instance. A model definition can therefore describe many actual vehicles. Anna is a salesperson at Northstar Motors. She selects a Vehicle__c record and creates a Test_Drive__c for client Irina. The field definitions, validation rules, Apex classes, and Flow definitions are metadata: instructions that describe how the application behaves. The particular vehicle and appointment are business data. Changing a field definition and inserting an appointment are different operations, even though both can begin in Setup or a browser. A runtime is the software that interprets those definitions and executes the application. You do not need to know the physical database layout to design this feature. You do need to know which operations share a transaction. A transaction is a unit of work whose database changes can commit together or roll back together when its execution fails. The user's click is an entry point, not a guarantee that everything it eventually causes belongs to one transaction.

Anna's authenticated session identifies the caller; the application still needs to validate the requested vehicle, appointment time, and permitted operation. Object permissions, field permissions, and record access answer different questions. For Apex compiled at API 68.0, database operations default to user mode. Prefer an explicit access contract in examples so reviewers do not have to infer the intent from a class version. Next draw the synchronous save path: request handling, applicable platform validation and automation, and the commit decision. This is a conceptual boundary diagram, not a replacement for the complete order-of-execution reference. A before-save change to the same appointment belongs inside that work. A Queueable job that runs later gets a separate execution context. If it fails after the appointment has committed, its failure does not travel backward and undo the earlier commit.

04 · Why shared infrastructure affects your design

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «Why shared infrastructure affects your design». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

Multitenancy means a platform serves multiple tenants while maintaining separation between their data and operations. An org is a tenant boundary; it is not permission for every user inside that org to see every record. Governor limits constrain individual executions, while other allocations apply across the org or a time window. These controls are part of the platform contract, so a design should budget work rather than assume unlimited processing. Hyperforce concerns Salesforce's infrastructure architecture and deployment on public-cloud infrastructure. It does not turn an inefficient nested loop into an efficient algorithm, merge independent transactions, or remove the application security model. Regional availability and organizational requirements can affect an infrastructure decision, but they do not establish a particular CPU entitlement for your code.

Oleg, the manager, needs to distinguish an appointment that was never created from one whose notification failed. A useful application status might track Pending, Delivered, and Needs attention for the notification separately from the appointment's booking status. Those fields are a proposed extension, not fields already supplied by the starter. Keep the business state and delivery state separate so a retry cannot accidentally rebook Irina. Measure each boundary independently in a permitted training environment: whether the appointment exists after the save, whether a queued job reached a terminal status, and whether a mocked recipient acknowledged the message. A screenshot of the appointment proves neither a network delivery nor the correctness of a retry. In a paper-only exercise, label every status transition as a prediction and explain how a future experiment would verify it.

02 · One complaint can describe four different problems

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «One complaint can describe four different problems». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

Oleg says that Salesforce is slow, but Anna says booking a test-drive is acceptable. Max says opening the vehicle list is frustrating, and the integration team says the overnight import finishes after staff arrive. These statements do not contradict each other. They refer to different operations, users, data sets, and finish lines. Treat the complaint as a request to investigate, not as proof that Apex or the database is responsible. Latency is how long one operation takes from a defined start to a defined finish. Throughput is how many useful operations finish in a period. Backlog is work waiting to finish. Improving one does not guarantee improving the others. Moving work into a queue can reduce Anna's wait while increasing the time before Oleg sees an updated report.

03 · Make the measurement boundary explicit

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «Make the measurement boundary explicit». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

For a vehicle search, a useful start is Max submitting the search, and a useful finish is the moment the result rows can be used. A network response arriving is an intermediate point if the browser then spends another second rendering. For a booking, distinguish 'saved in Salesforce' from 'confirmed by the external scheduling system.' If the product only promises the first, measuring the second without saying so creates an impossible comparison. Write the population beside the metric: user persona, permissions, browser, device, network, selected filters, approximate record distribution, and relevant automation. A broad-access administrator can produce different results from Anna. A warm cache can hide the cost of a fresh visit. Record these conditions before comparing a change, and keep them reasonably consistent afterward.

04 · Read the case without inventing evidence

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «Read the case without inventing evidence». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

The table below is a synthetic intake artifact. It contains business complaints and possible targets, not verified timings. 'Usually three seconds' is a person's estimate. It is useful for prioritization, but it is not a measured baseline. A target becomes meaningful only after the business confirms that the finish line represents useful work. Prioritize the list-open journey if Max repeats it many times per hour and the wasted time is material. Investigate the import separately because its deadline and recovery needs differ. Do not merge them into a single average named 'Salesforce performance.' Assign an owner to each measurement and define how a missed target changes the business process, such as delayed customer calls.

05 · Agree on a target and a stop condition

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «Agree on a target and a stop condition». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

An improvement statement could be: 'For the defined vehicle-list journey, reduce measured user wait while preserving the same visible records, columns required for the task, and access rules.' Add a numerical target only after obtaining a baseline and business agreement. Avoid a precise promised speedup derived from a synthetic example. Specify guardrails alongside the target. For example, no increase in authorization errors, no missing required rows, and no unacceptable shift of work into a growing queue. These are conditions under which an apparent speedup should be rejected. A faster page with incorrect data is not a successful optimization.

02 · Follow a request rather than a collection of tools

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «Follow a request rather than a collection of tools». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

Max opens Northstar's vehicle search. The browser can wait before sending a request, transfer a response, process JavaScript, and render rows. Salesforce can spend time running application logic, accessing data, and waiting for a callout. These stages explain different parts of the wait. Opening every diagnostic tool at once creates more output, but it does not automatically establish a causal sequence. Use a correlation identifier: a value that lets you associate records about the same request or business operation. Prefer a non-sensitive generated identifier over Irina's email or a complete request body. In a small experiment, a run label and carefully recorded timestamps may be enough. At greater scale, define how the identifier travels across application logs, integration attempts, and support reports.

03 · CPU time is only one clock

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «CPU time is only one clock». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

Apex CPU time measures application-server processing attributed to the transaction. The database-processing portion of SOQL and DML, and time waiting for an external callout, are not counted as Apex CPU. Application work around those operations can still consume CPU. Consequently, a request can take several seconds while its reported CPU is much smaller. It can also fail the CPU limit even when its queries individually look quick. The synthetic example below places an external availability check on the critical path. The critical path is the chain of dependent work that determines when the user can continue. If rendering requires the callout result, improving a small collection loop will not remove the wait for that result. If the availability check can move to a later explicit step without breaking the business promise, the dependency itself may be the more valuable design question.

Перед запуском используй prerequisites и точную команду из урока. Запиши фактический вывод, включая ошибку, если она возникла.

04 · Test competing explanations

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «Test competing explanations». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

Write two hypotheses: the slow callout controls the delay, or a large response controls browser rendering. For the first, replace the external dependency with a controlled test double in a suitable test path and compare the request's structure and elapsed behavior. A test double is a stand-in with a deliberate response, not a secretly faster production service. For the second, compare a reduced required field set and a smaller initial result page while keeping the user task equivalent. Change one meaningful variable at a time. Keep the same user permissions, filters, and application revision. Record whether caches were already populated. Capture several runs, including errors, rather than keeping only the fastest example. Heavy debug logging can affect an experiment and produce large files; use an appropriate logging scope and avoid publishing records or credentials.

05 · What a small org can and cannot establish

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «What a small org can and cannot establish». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

In a training org, you can compare two LWC rendering approaches, observe request timing, or inspect a bounded Apex collection operation. These experiments teach how to attribute delay. They do not reproduce production network paths, a large sharing model, data skew, or concurrent dealer traffic. A good submission states the exact claim it supports, such as 'this change reduces repeated client processing for this fixture.' Your evidence package should include a sanitized timeline, the relevant code difference, raw observation rows, and a short explanation of remaining uncertainty. Avoid exporting an entire browser archive without reviewing its contents: network captures can include sensitive headers and data. A concise redrawn timeline is often sufficient for a classroom review.

02 · A limit and an allocation answer different questions

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «A limit and an allocation answer different questions». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

A per-transaction limit bounds one execution. An allocation can constrain an organization over a period or another shared scope. Capacity is the amount of useful work a system can complete under defined conditions. These concepts are related, but they are not interchangeable. An appointment handler can fit comfortably inside its own transaction limits while thousands of invocations consume a shared allowance or overwhelm a downstream service. Northstar expects more dealers to use Anna's booking process. Oleg asks whether ten times as many appointments means ten times as much CPU in one transaction. Usually the first question is how requests are grouped. Ten independent requests differ from one bulk update containing many records, and both differ from a background process that queries additional related data. State the execution shape before doing arithmetic.

03 · Calculate a transparent demand model

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «Calculate a transparent demand model». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

The fixture assumes one notification request per accepted booking and a separate reconciliation request per group of fifty bookings. These are invented design inputs. At 100 bookings per minute, the model predicts 100 notification requests and two reconciliation requests per minute, before retries. Multiply by the active minutes in the business day rather than automatically assuming round-the-clock traffic. Include a separate allowance for replays, retries, and administrative operations. Now inspect the work inside a save. A handler that issues one query per appointment grows differently from a handler that queries relevant vehicles once for the whole collection. Do not extrapolate CPU as perfectly linear without measuring it: branching, sharing checks, record distribution, and downstream automation can change the relationship. Use the small experiment to identify the shape of the work, then retain uncertainty around its production cost.

🎬 ЭКРАН · КОД. Открой пример «Synthetic assumptions for a spreadsheet, not measured capacity» рядом с ожидаемым результатом. Выделяй вход, решение и выход; не читай весь листинг вслух. Перед запуском используй prerequisites и точную команду из урока. Запиши фактический вывод, включая ошибку, если она возникла.

04 · Queue growth reveals a different failure

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «Queue growth reveals a different failure». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

Suppose a simulated worker completes 80 notifications per minute while 100 arrive. The backlog grows by approximately twenty per minute under those assumptions. Moving the publisher into Queueable does not remove that difference. It changes when the user waits and which execution limits apply. Queue age, the time the oldest pending item has waited, often describes business impact better than queue length alone. During recovery, capacity must serve new arrivals and reduce old work. A worker that merely matches current arrival rate cannot drain the accumulated backlog. This is a planning equation, not a promise that Salesforce will provide a constant worker rate. Async scheduling is affected by shared resources and platform policies; avoid presenting it as an exact start-time guarantee.

05 · Turn the estimate into a verification plan

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «Turn the estimate into a verification plan». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

Use a small set of synthetic records to compare bulk and single-record execution. Record relevant counters before and after a bounded operation, preserve the same business assertions, and note other automation that ran. A tiny org cannot validate an enterprise rate forecast, but it can reveal an obvious query-per-record pattern. Produce a capacity sheet with assumptions, derived demand, current documented constraints, and unknowns. Highlight the constraint that could be reached first. Recommend a controlled test in an authorized representative environment, including a stop condition for errors or queue growth. The useful output is an honest decision boundary, not a large spreadsheet full of unverified precision.

02 · The longest code file is not automatically the best target

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «The longest code file is not automatically the best target». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Northstar has five proposed improvements: reduce the vehicle list's initial payload, replace a nested lookup loop, move a slow optional callout out of the save path, rewrite every Flow in Apex, and add a cache to a rarely used report. Oleg can fund only two this iteration. A senior recommendation should connect each change to a specific complaint, not simply prefer the most technically interesting option. Value depends on frequency and consequence as well as duration. Saving half a second on an action repeated constantly may matter more than saving several seconds on a monthly administrative task. A correctness defect or a missed operational deadline can outweigh both. Write the affected population and business consequence before comparing implementation effort.

03 · Use a small decision table

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «Use a small decision table». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

Expected direction can be useful without an exact percentage. Reducing unused response fields should reduce payload size; it does not by itself establish how much faster Max's complete journey becomes. The synthetic evidence cards below support investigating the payload and collection loop first. They do not prove either is the final production bottleneck. The broad rewrite has a large change surface and no isolated explanation for the reported symptoms. A change surface is the set of behaviors and components that might be affected. Larger surfaces demand more regression evidence and can make recovery harder.

05 · Plan the release and the decision to stop

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «Plan the release and the decision to stop». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

A reversible change has a practical way back to the previous behavior. A feature toggle may help separate deployment from user exposure, but the team must test both paths and define who changes the toggle. Removing data or changing an external contract can require a recovery plan beyond a code revert. After the chosen change, compare the agreed signals. If improvement is smaller than hoped, revisit the hypothesis rather than selecting a more flattering metric. If the target is met and the remaining imperfection has low business impact, stop. Every additional optimization has an opportunity cost and can introduce a new defect.

02 · Indexes narrow a search only when the filter helps

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «Indexes narrow a search only when the filter helps». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

An index is a data structure the platform may use to locate matching records efficiently. Selectivity describes how narrowly a condition reduces the candidate data set, under the optimizer's rules. A field can have an index while a particular value matches most records. In that case, following the index may not be the cheapest plan. Anna opens active appointments at her dealer. A year ago, Status__c = 'Requested' matched a small fraction of appointments. In the synthetic growth case, a failed completion process leaves most appointments Requested. The query text is unchanged, but the data distribution is different. Adding an index without examining that distribution may leave the underlying problem untouched.

03 · Read a plan as an estimate

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «Read a plan as an estimate». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

The Query Plan tool exposes candidate plans and estimates such as cardinality and relative cost. Cardinality is the estimated number of matching rows. A plan is evidence about how the optimizer sees this query in this environment; it is not a promise of a particular number of milliseconds. Different filters, values, and data volumes can produce different plans. The synthetic snapshots below deliberately omit exact platform threshold calculations. They show a broad status filter and a narrower combination of dealer and date. In the starter, Dealer_Code__c is a proposed exercise field, not existing metadata. If you add it for a local experiment, record its definition and whether an index is actually available. Do not label an arbitrary custom field 'indexed' because its name sounds important.

04 · Keep query design and application design connected

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «Keep query design and application design connected». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

Request only fields needed for the current operation, use appropriate filters, and paginate when the user cannot meaningfully consume every row at once. Reducing selected fields can reduce payload and memory even when it does not change the leading query plan. Pagination choices have their own contracts: SOQL OFFSET has a maximum offset and does not provide a stable snapshot across changing data. Do not move a broad query into Batch and conclude that the query is fixed. Batch can change how work is divided, but start still needs a viable selection strategy. Likewise, replacing the query with a cache creates freshness, invalidation, and authorization questions. Consider those alternatives only when they fit the business journey.

02 · Different child records can share one contested resource

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «Different child records can share one contested resource». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

Record locking protects data consistency while an operation changes records. Contention occurs when concurrent operations need the same protected resource. Max and Anna may edit different appointments on screen yet trigger automation that updates the same Vehicle__c summary. Their visible records differ, but their transactions compete for a shared vehicle record. Start from the complete operation, including triggers, Flows, roll-ups, sharing maintenance, and relationship behavior. A lookup does not mean that every possible update always locks every ancestor. Locking depends on the object, relationship settings, and operations performed. The correct question is which shared record or membership resource this particular transaction needs, not whether two users clicked different rows.

03 · Recognize concentration in the data model

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «Recognize concentration in the data model». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

Data skew is an uneven distribution that concentrates work or access maintenance. Account skew can involve many children under one Account. Lookup skew concentrates references to one target. Ownership skew concentrates many records under one owner, potentially making role or sharing changes expensive. These patterns are warning signs, not automatic proof of the same failure mechanism. Northstar's synthetic model uses one 'Unassigned vehicle' record for many appointments. A handler also updates its Last_Activity__c on every appointment save. Last_Activity__c is a proposed exercise field. The model creates a hot record: a record many transactions repeatedly need. Replacing Anna's trigger with Queueable does not remove the shared target. It may simply move the contention into another queue.

🎬 ЭКРАН · КОД. Открой пример «Synthetic contention trace» рядом с ожидаемым результатом. Выделяй вход, решение и выход; не читай весь листинг вслух. Перед запуском используй prerequisites и точную команду из урока. Запиши фактический вывод, включая ошибку, если она возникла.

04 · Choose a remedy that changes the cause

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «Choose a remedy that changes the cause». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

Partitioning groups work so concurrent workers operate on independent resources. For this example, route appointments for the same vehicle through one coordinated stream while allowing different vehicles to proceed independently. Merely sorting a file is not enough if the ingestion mechanism later splits it into overlapping parallel work. Verify the actual partition boundary. Serialization processes conflicting work one at a time. It can improve useful throughput when parallel attempts spend most of their time failing and retrying, although it reduces theoretical concurrency. Shortening the transaction can reduce how long a lock is held. Removing an unnecessary summary write may be better than optimizing its retry policy.

05 · Use a trace or a small controlled experiment

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «Use a trace or a small controlled experiment». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

A small training org may not reproduce a contention error reliably. Scheduling and timing are not under your complete control, so a demonstration that happened not to fail does not disprove the mechanism. You can still inspect a proposed automation graph, count shared targets, and compare the intended partitioning. If you run a small experiment, use synthetic records, a bounded number of operations, and an explicit stop condition. Record completed operations, failures, retry count, and elapsed wall time. Do not add artificial busy loops or unbounded traffic merely to force a lock. The goal is to evaluate a hypothesis safely, not to stress a shared learning environment.

02 · A data load is a business transformation

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «A data load is a business transformation». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

Northstar receives vehicles and appointments from a dealer management system, abbreviated DMS. The DMS stores each vehicle under a stable source identifier. Salesforce needs a reliable way to recognize that the same source vehicle has arrived again. A CSV row number is not such an identity: sorting or splitting the file changes it. An External ID field can support matching imported data to existing Salesforce records, but you must inspect its configuration and uniqueness requirements. The starter includes VIN__c; do not assume that any field named VIN is automatically the correct external identifier for every source. For the exercise, propose a Source_Key__c field with an explicit matching policy and document it as an extension.

03 · Preserve identity through every result file

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «Preserve identity through every result file». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

Create a separate five-row vehicle fixture with keys V-001 through V-005, leaving V-MISSING and V-MISSING-2 absent for the first attempt. The two A-101 rows are complete snapshots at versions 1 and 2. Before upload, retain version 2 and record version 1 as superseded. Do not submit competing versions together and assume CSV order makes the latest one win. Upsert matches identities; it does not supply a version policy. Bulk API results distinguish successful, failed, and unprocessed records. Failed means processing encountered an error. Unprocessed means processing did not take place, such as when a job is interrupted. These categories need different operational explanations even if both eventually require attention. Do not rely on returned result ordering matching the original CSV order.

04 · Control replays and concurrency

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «Control replays and concurrency». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

After correcting a missing parent, repeat only the relevant failed or unprocessed work unless your entire operation is deliberately idempotent and a broader replay is justified. Use the same business identity for a retry of the same action. Assigning a new random key on every attempt defeats duplicate detection. Choose the API and loading mechanism explicitly. Bulk API 2.0 handles batching for you; do not assume that every tuning option from the original Bulk API exists there. If your design requires a serial-processing capability, verify which supported tool or API provides it. Alternatively, coordinate independent jobs or change the data partition with full awareness of how the service processes them.

A few synthetic records are enough to demonstrate matching, dependencies, rejected rows, and a replay. Use a local spreadsheet ledger if no suitable org is available. Mark predicted outcomes as predictions. If you execute a small load, save sanitized result rows and the precise metadata configuration that controls matching. Before a real migration, add preparation steps for backups, permissions, source cutover, user communication, and reconciliation ownership. Those are decisions to review with the responsible team, not instructions to run against an employer's org. Retain result artifacts according to the agreed operational policy rather than assuming the API keeps them forever.

02 · Older does not automatically mean unnecessary

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «Older does not automatically mean unnecessary». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

Anna usually needs upcoming appointments and recent follow-ups. Oleg also needs historical conversion reports, while Irina may ask about a past visit. These journeys have different access patterns. Archiving moves or manages information so it no longer burdens the main operational path while remaining available under an explicit retrieval policy. Deletion removes it from that path and may eventually make recovery impossible. A backup supports recovery after loss or corruption. An archive supports deliberate long-term retention and retrieval. Audit history explains changes or events, and is not necessarily a complete copy of every business record and relationship. One mechanism may help with more than one purpose, but you must verify its actual guarantees rather than treating the labels as synonyms.

03 · Define policy as a set of testable decisions

The fictional proposal below is an exercise, not a legal or compliance recommendation. Oleg suggests archiving completed appointments after a defined operational period, but the responsible business and data-governance owners must decide the real period, exceptions, and approval process. Do not infer a universal Salesforce or automotive retention requirement. Classify records by lifecycle, not just CreatedDate. A very old appointment may still have an unresolved complaint, a linked obligation, or a correction in progress. Your selection rule needs exceptions and a way to prevent records from moving while they remain active. For the Vehicle__c lookup, decide whether the archive retains the relevant vehicle attributes, a stable reference, or both.

04 · Compare storage choices against retrieval needs

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «Compare storage choices against retrieval needs». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

Keeping history in core Salesforce preserves familiar relationships and reporting, but it may maintain storage and access-maintenance costs. A supported archive product can provide managed policies and retrieval features, subject to its licensing and product constraints. An external archive can suit some access patterns but requires integration, authorization, search design, and operations. Big Objects or other storage options are not drop-in replacements for every ordinary object query or report. Create a fit table rather than declaring one option cheapest. Compare required searches, reporting freshness, relationship preservation, restoration granularity, operating effort, product availability, and expected cost categories. If pricing or licensing is unknown, mark it as a question rather than filling in an invented dollar value.

A small proxy can use ten synthetic appointments and an archive manifest. A manifest is a list describing what was copied, its identifiers, counts, and verification information. Show that an allowed user can retrieve a selected historical visit, that an unauthorized persona cannot, and that the required report still reconciles. Record retrieval time, missing references, mismatched counts, and restoration limitations. If you only designed the exercise, leave the observation cells empty and describe the planned checks. A storage estimate alone cannot show whether a customer's question can still be answered.

02 · Start with people doing work

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «Start with people doing work». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

Anna sells vehicles at Northstar East. Max works at Northstar West. Oleg manages both dealers, and a central service team handles appointments across selected branches. Irina is a fictional client represented by business data, not automatically a Salesforce user. These roles describe business responsibilities; they do not yet prescribe profiles, Salesforce roles, or licenses. Object and field permissions define what a user can do with a kind of record and its fields. Record access determines which particular records are available. A permission set for booking work should not automatically imply visibility into every dealer. Conversely, a sharing rule that exposes an appointment does not supply missing object or field permissions.

03 · Compare two plausible record models

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «Compare two plausible record models». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

In one model, appointments are owned by individual salespeople, with a compact managerial role structure and dealer-specific sharing groups. In another, ownership is more centralized and access is assigned through explicit business groups. Neither is universally correct. Individual ownership supports some workflows naturally but makes staff turnover and transfers important. Central ownership can simplify one process while concentrating records and making sharing maintenance expensive. Role hierarchy access normally opens records upward through the hierarchy; two peers do not automatically gain each other's records just because their job titles match. Custom objects can have relevant hierarchy settings, so record the actual configuration. Public groups collect users or supported membership types for access rules; their maintenance and nesting also need operational ownership.

04 · Design for changes, not only today's screenshot

Test a transfer: Anna moves from East to West. Decide whether her historical East appointments remain visible, move to another owner, or follow a separate historical policy. Removing her from a group may not close access if she still owns the records or another sharing path remains. Changing role membership or ownership at scale can trigger expensive access recalculation. Test opening a third dealer, replacing a manager, and adding a temporary service exception. Count the kinds of configuration changes required rather than promising a precise recalculation time. A model requiring hundreds of manual shares every week has a different support burden from a rule based on stable business criteria.

Use two or three internal test personas as licensing permits, or rotate permissions carefully in a training org while recording each configuration. Check both allowed and denied operations through the actual user-facing path. An administrator's successful query does not prove Anna's access is correct. Your small matrix verifies intended access semantics. It does not benchmark a network-wide role reorganization. For scale, document likely high-impact changes, record ownership concentration, group maintenance, and a representative-environment validation plan. Keep a business-readable diagram beside the technical configuration so Oleg can verify that the rules match responsibility.

02 · An effective right can have several sources

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «An effective right can have several sources». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

Max can edit an East appointment even though the team deleted a sharing rule. The deletion removed one source of record access, not necessarily all sources. Max might own the record, have hierarchy access, belong to another shared group, receive an explicit share, or hold a broad permission that bypasses ordinary record sharing. Investigate the operation, object, field, and record separately. Effective access means the result of all applicable grants and restrictions in the actual execution path. A screenshot of one permission set is not a complete explanation. Likewise, a successful Apex endpoint can reflect its execution mode rather than Max's normal interface access. Record the entry point and Apex API version when code is involved.

03 · Muting is local to a permission set group

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «Muting is local to a permission set group». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

A permission set group bundles permission sets for a work responsibility. Its muting permission set removes selected permissions from that group's contribution. It is not a global deny that overrides the profile, a separately assigned permission set, or another group. This additive model explains why a muted permission can remain effective. The synthetic inventory below gives Max Edit from two independent places. Muting the group removes one contribution; the direct assignment still provides Edit. Removing the direct assignment may still be insufficient to prevent editing a particular record if another object-level source remains. Also inspect dependencies: muting a foundational permission can affect related permissions within the group's effective result.

04 · Build a removal plan with observable outcomes

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «Build a removal plan with observable outcomes». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

Start with the business reason: Max should stop editing East appointments after temporary collaboration ends, while continuing to edit his approved West work. Determine whether the intended change concerns object Edit, East record access, or both. Removing object Edit globally might solve the East symptom by unnecessarily breaking West work. Create a before-and-after matrix of allowed and denied actions. Include normal interface use, relevant API or Apex entry points, sensitive fields, and any supported restrictions. Restriction rules can narrow existing record visibility for supported objects and contexts; they do not grant missing access. Do not assume that multiple matching restriction rules combine into a reliable AND policy.

05 · Treat the audit as maintained evidence

02 · Deferral changes timing, not the intended access policy

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «Deferral changes timing, not the intended access policy». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

Northstar is reorganizing dealer groups and roles. Recalculating sharing rules after every individual change may create unnecessary repeated work. Sharing-rule deferral can temporarily suspend relevant automatic calculations while a planned set of changes is made. The target access policy remains the business requirement; deferral is an operational timing mechanism. Availability matters. The feature is not enabled by default in every org, and Salesforce documentation describes contacting Support to enable it. The operator also needs the relevant permissions. This classroom exercise does not ask you to enable the feature, reorganize a real role hierarchy, or assume that a Developer Edition can reproduce a large maintenance event.

03 · Know exactly what is paused

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «Know exactly what is paused». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

Deferring sharing-rule calculations does not freeze every sharing-related mechanism. Manual shares and changes involving teams or queues can still be evaluated. Some role changes matter to sharing rules while other changes do not fall under the same deferral. Group-membership calculations have their own considerations; do not collapse all these mechanisms into a single 'security off' switch. Existing record access can temporarily differ from the intended final configuration while changes await recalculation. This creates a business and access-management risk, not simply a performance benefit. Define which users and operations may continue during the window, how unexpected visibility will be handled, and who can stop the procedure.

🎬 ЭКРАН · КОД. Открой пример «Synthetic maintenance rehearsal» рядом с ожидаемым результатом. Выделяй вход, решение и выход; не читай весь листинг вслух. Перед запуском используй prerequisites и точную команду из урока. Запиши фактический вывод, включая ошибку, если она возникла.

The example on screen is Synthetic maintenance rehearsal. Before running it, identify the input, the branch that makes the decision, and the result we expect. We will compare that expectation with the actual output.

04 · Resume and Recalculate are different gates

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «Resume and Recalculate are different gates». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

Resume re-enables automatic handling of new changes. It does not replace the required full recalculation for changes accumulated during suspension. If the operator stops after Resume, the configuration may look finished while record access still reflects stale calculations. The runbook must therefore have two separate completion checks. After requesting recalculation, monitor the supported status signals and wait for the relevant work to complete before declaring success. Then execute the persona matrix: Anna's East appointments, Max's West appointments, Oleg's managerial view, and explicitly denied cross-dealer cases. Include exceptions that should have expired.

Create three tabletop failure cards: the change list is only partially applied, the operator resumes but forgets recalculation, and a manual share is added during the window. For each, explain the expected uncertainty and the next safe decision. Avoid inventing automatic rollback guarantees. Measure the operation through checkpoint timestamps, configuration counts, recalculation status, verification coverage, and unresolved exceptions. In a real approved environment these become observations. In this lesson they remain a plan unless you perform a separately authorized small test.

By the end, you should be able to show the result and explain how you checked it. The contract does not trust a client-supplied customer Id as proof of ownership. Identity, CRUD/FLS, record sharing, and payload validation are treated separately.

02 · Name the caller and the requested action

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «Name the caller and the requested action». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

An external portal asks Salesforce to retrieve Irina's appointment. The request contains an appointment Id and a customer identifier. Neither value is proof that the caller is entitled to that appointment. Authentication establishes who the caller is; authorization establishes what that identity may do. Input validation checks whether the supplied values are acceptable for the operation. These checks solve different problems. A trust boundary separates information or actions with different assumptions about who controls them. Browser input, integration payloads, and model-generated tool arguments should cross that boundary as untrusted data. The server should derive or verify the permitted customer relationship rather than accepting a caller's claim that a record belongs to them.

03 · Read both the class and the operation mode

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «Read both the class and the operation mode». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

Sharing keywords govern record-level behavior in Apex contexts, while database operation modes affect the operation's security checks. With API 68.0, the newer default database mode is user mode. An explicit WITH USER_MODE query applies the user's sharing, object, and field checks even when the surrounding class is declared without sharing. Conversely, specifying system mode does not mean that a with-sharing class has automatically become without sharing. This is why 'the class is with sharing' is not a complete security review, and 'Apex always ignores permissions' is an outdated blanket statement. Inspect the class version, call path, sharing declaration, and each operation's intended mode. Explicitly document any elevation rather than depending on an implicit default inherited from an old example.

🎬 ЭКРАН · КОД. Открой пример «API 68.0 illustration: user-mode query, not a complete endpoint» рядом с ожидаемым результатом. Выделяй вход, решение и выход; не читай весь листинг вслух. Перед запуском используй prerequisites и точную команду из урока. Запиши фактический вывод, включая ошибку, если она возникла.

The example on screen is API 68.0 illustration: user-mode query, not a complete endpoint. Before running it, identify the input, the branch that makes the decision, and the result we expect. We will compare that expectation with the actual output.

04 · If elevation is needed, make its scope small

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «If elevation is needed, make its scope small». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

A maintenance service might legitimately update a derived status across records that Anna cannot edit directly. That does not justify exposing an unrestricted 'update any object' method to her browser. Define the exact action, allowed records, permitted fields, initiating identity, and auditable reason. Keep privileged code behind a narrow boundary and validate its caller before performing elevated work. Use an allowlist when client input controls a structural choice such as a sort field or operation name. Bind values in queries where supported, but do not assume a bound filter value validates an independently concatenated field name. If using stripInaccessible, use the returned cleaned records and understand that field stripping is not a substitute for the full record-access policy.

05 · Prove the denied paths

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «Prove the denied paths». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

Build a synthetic matrix: an authorized appointment, another client's appointment, a nonexistent Id, a forbidden field, and a malformed operation request. Decide whether the response should reveal that a hidden record exists. Errors should be useful without disclosing another customer's data. Run a small permitted test under genuinely limited personas when available. Otherwise produce a threat review and an executable test plan, clearly marked unexecuted. Record the security context with each result. A test that passes under an administrator says little about the portal caller.

02 · One business process can have several authoritative systems

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «One business process can have several authoritative systems». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Northstar uses Salesforce for customer interactions, a dealer management system for workshop operations, and a stock service for vehicle availability. A system of record is the authoritative source for a particular fact. It does not have to own every field about an entity. Salesforce may own the requested appointment while the scheduling system owns the confirmed workshop slot. Make ownership precise at the field or decision level. If both systems can independently declare the same slot reserved, a conflict policy is required. Copying the value into Salesforce does not transfer authority. Distinguish the authoritative state from a cached or replicated view, and show when the view was last refreshed.

03 · Match the pattern to the business promise

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «Match the pattern to the business promise». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

A synchronous request asks another system for an answer while the caller waits. It fits a decision that requires a current authoritative result, but introduces a dependency into the user's critical path. An asynchronous message decouples timing, but the interface must communicate pending work and eventual outcomes. Batch synchronization moves a set of changes periodically; it can suit information whose freshness tolerance is larger. Virtual access reads information without necessarily maintaining a full local copy. It can reduce duplication, but availability, query support, performance, authorization, and product licensing must fit the use case. It is not automatically simpler just because less data is stored locally.

02 · Delivery and business effects have different identities

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «Delivery and business effects have different identities». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Northstar receives appointment-status events from its scheduling service. An event identifier names a particular message. A business operation identifier names the action that message represents. A replay position tells a subscriber where it is in a stream. These values may be related, but they are not interchangeable. A publisher can send the same business operation again as a new event after a timeout. Deduplicating only the event identifier would not recognize that second message as the same operation. Conversely, two valid updates to the same appointment are not duplicates merely because they share an appointment Id. Define the unit you intend to apply once.

03 · Choose a version policy that matches the payload

The synthetic events below carry a complete current status and a monotonically increasing version assigned by the authoritative scheduling system. Under that explicit contract, version 3 can replace version 1, and a later arrival of version 2 should not move the appointment backward. The version is scoped to one appointment; it does not order all activity across every dealer. A delta event, such as 'increase reserved capacity by one,' needs different treatment. Skipping an earlier delta because a higher version arrived can lose part of the calculation. Do not reuse the snapshot-state policy without checking the payload meaning. You may need ordered processing, gap detection, or reconciliation with the source.

04 · Make the state change and deduplication durable

An in-memory Set disappears when the worker restarts. For effects that must survive a restart, use durable state: for example, an operation ledger or a stored source version with a suitable uniqueness and concurrency strategy. If two workers can race, a check-then-insert sequence without protection can allow both to act. Explain where uniqueness or transaction coordination closes that gap. When both the ledger update and the business update occur inside one Salesforce transaction, they can be designed to commit or fail together. A remote email or external reservation is outside that local database transaction. Its own idempotency key, acknowledgment, and recovery contract are still necessary. A Salesforce rollback cannot unsend a remote message already accepted elsewhere.

02 · Retries are additional load

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «Retries are additional load». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

The scheduling service becomes unavailable while Anna and Max continue creating permitted Pending requests. If every failure retries immediately, the system produces more requests precisely when the dependency has less capacity. This is a retry storm: repeated attempts amplify the original outage and can consume Salesforce resources as well. Begin with failure classification. A malformed request missing a required vehicle key will not repair itself through repeated identical calls. A temporary connectivity failure might recover. A timeout is especially important because the remote system may have completed the operation before the response was lost. That attempt needs idempotency or reconciliation, not an assumption that nothing happened.

03 · Define a bounded policy

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «Define a bounded policy». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

Backoff increases the delay between attempts. Jitter adds a controlled random spread so many workers do not retry at exactly the same instant. A retry bound limits the number of attempts or the total age of retryable work. These are policy choices to test against the service contract, not universal magic numbers. The synthetic policy below separates temporary errors from validation failures and unknown outcomes. Its delays are example design values, not Salesforce scheduling guarantees. A worker should store a future eligibility time or use an appropriate supported scheduling mechanism; do not hold an Apex transaction open by busy-waiting for the delay.

04 · Preserve failed work and make ownership clear

An error queue is a durable list of work requiring attention, sometimes called a dead-letter queue. It is not a place to hide records forever. Include a concise error category, the relevant business identifier, the last attempt, and the action required. Avoid storing unnecessary customer details or complete authentication-bearing requests. Oleg should see the number and age of unresolved bookings, while the operator can distinguish data correction from dependency recovery. A retry button should not blindly assign a new operation identity. Reusing the same business key allows the service to recognize a previously completed reservation.

05 · Recover at a controlled rate

After the dependency returns, do not release the entire backlog at once. First verify a small probe, then increase the allowed rate while watching errors, response time, and queue age. Capacity must handle both new requests and old work. If arrivals equal completions, the backlog does not shrink. The net drain is twenty per minute, so the model needs thirty minutes to clear the initial backlog, assuming those rates remain constant. This arithmetic is useful planning, not evidence of actual Salesforce or provider capacity.

02 · Begin with the customer outcome

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «Begin with the customer outcome». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

Irina did not receive a test-drive notification. Oleg sees a successful booking and a log message saying 'event published.' These facts do not establish that a notification provider received or delivered anything. Define the missing business outcome before searching for the most dramatic error line. Observability means having enough useful signals to understand what the system did and why. Logs describe individual events, metrics summarize behavior over time, and traces connect stages of an execution. None is sufficient alone. A low error count can coexist with missing work if the code never attempted the relevant stage or logged success too early.

03 · Follow the stages and their acknowledgments

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «Follow the stages and their acknowledgments». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

Platform Event publication is asynchronous. A successful SaveResult from EventBus.publish reports the intermediate queuing result, not the final publication result or a subscriber's business completion. Publish callbacks can report the final publication outcome for supported events, but even publication success does not prove that an external provider completed its work. The synthetic timeline below shows a mismatch between the dashboard's definition of success and the actual process. The subscriber attempted a provider call, timed out, and recorded no durable recovery state. The evidence supports a lost unresolved outcome; it does not prove whether the provider delivered the message before the timeout.

04 · Separate recovery from causal explanation

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «Separate recovery from causal explanation». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

The immediate recovery task is to reconcile N-77 with the provider or apply the approved idempotent retry procedure. Blindly sending a new notification with a new operation key can create duplicates. The incident explanation is a separate task: why did an uncertain outcome disappear, and why did the dashboard misreport it? A cause statement should connect a mechanism to evidence. 'The developer was careless' explains neither the status transition nor the missing recovery state. A stronger statement identifies that code used the queuing acknowledgment as a completed-notification signal and did not persist timeout handling. Contributing conditions might include a test suite that covered only successful responses.

05 · Measure the process that can fail silently

Add counts and age distributions for Pending notifications, attempts, confirmed provider acknowledgments, and unresolved outcomes. Alerting thresholds should reflect the business tolerance and observed normal behavior. Do not invent a universal threshold from this fictional incident. For longer interruptions, remember that an event bus is not an unlimited archive. Standard Platform Event and CDC retention is limited, and recovery beyond the available replay window may require reconciliation from durable business state. A checkpoint is useful, but it does not replace a recovery source.

02 · First discover what the old code actually does

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «First discover what the old code actually does». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

Northstar's appointment trigger validates status changes, updates a vehicle summary, creates a reminder, and calls a helper with unclear side effects. Nobody can confidently explain why some conditions are repeated. Oleg wants a new cancellation rule, but a full rewrite would change too many behaviors at once. A characterization test records the behavior of the existing implementation for a defined input. It is useful when documentation is incomplete. It does not declare every observed behavior correct. If the old handler creates duplicate reminders, a characterization test can reveal that fact, but the business still needs to decide the intended behavior before a corrective change.

03 · Build a behavior map before choosing a new design

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «Build a behavior map before choosing a new design». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

List entry points, records read, records changed, external effects, and the conditions controlling each effect. Include other automation that can run in the same transaction. A trigger handler is not isolated merely because it is stored in one class. A Flow may update the record again, and an integration may enter through a different route. Use the synthetic cases below to define a minimal behavior envelope. An envelope is the set of behavior you intend to keep stable during the first change. Include empty input, a normal transition, an unchanged status, a mixed bulk collection, and a rejected transition. Count side effects as well as checking the final field value.

04 · Extract one responsibility behind a seam

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «Extract one responsibility behind a seam». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

A seam is a boundary where one part of the implementation can be replaced or tested independently. Start by extracting a pure status-decision function: given old and new state, what action should occur? Keep the trigger's collection handling and persistence contract stable while this decision logic moves. A pure function returns a result without performing hidden database or network work, which makes it easier to test. Do not immediately create a large framework with many layers. The first extraction should reduce a specific source of uncertainty. For example, separating 'should create a reminder' from 'insert reminder records' lets tests verify transition decisions without making every test depend on a complete org configuration.

05 · Use meaningful regression evidence

🎬 ЭКРАН. Раздел «Use meaningful regression evidence». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

Tests should verify outcomes and absence of unintended work. A line-coverage number only shows which lines executed; it does not prove that a reminder was created once, that a denied transition stayed denied, or that a later batch of trigger records was processed. An early return controlled by one transaction-wide static Boolean is a useful review target. It can suppress legitimate later work as well as recursion. Prefer business transition checks and deliberately scoped coordination over a blanket 'already ran' flag. Any stateful guard should explain what it tracks and when repeated processing is valid.
